countries.name: India
countries.summary: India's higher-education system is overseen by the Ministry of Education and its statutory regulators - the University Grants Commission for universities and degrees, the All India Council for Technical Education for technical and management programmes, and the National Medical Commission for medical education. International applicants normally enter through an institution's own international-admissions office, through the government's Study in India portal, or through a centrally administered scheme such as DASA for engineering and architecture seats at NITs, IIITs and other centrally funded technical institutes. Entry rules differ by nationality, residency status, the prior qualification held and the discipline chosen.
countries.whyStudentsChooseIt: International applicants look at India for English-taught degrees across computing, engineering, management, design, sciences, law and health disciplines, and for a single national application route: the Ministry of Education's Study in India portal issues an SII ID and lets an applicant send one profile to several participating institutes. Government-funded study places also exist through Indian Council for Cultural Relations scholarship schemes, which are applied for through Indian diplomatic missions rather than directly to a university. What an individual applicant can access depends on citizenship, residency status, how the prior qualification is assessed for equivalence, and whether the programme is attached to a national entrance test.
countries.climate: Climate varies widely by region, from alpine Himalayan conditions in the north to tropical coastal and semi-arid zones further south, with a June-to-September monsoon across most of the country.
countries.metaTitle: Study in India: Guide for International Students
countries.metaDescription: Regulators, admission routes, entrance tests, student visa and FRRO rules that international applicants should verify before applying to an Indian university.

universities.name: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute of Science and Technology
universities.summary: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute of Science and Technology is a private self-financed university in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, established in 1996. The institute offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across engineering, technology, management and sciences. It holds approval from the All India Council for Technical Education (LoA from 2018-19 with continuous Extension of Approval through 2026-27) and is affiliated to the Anna University for certain technical programmes. The institute operates three schools - Computing, Bio Engineering, and Electrical & Communication Engineering - along with a School of Mechanical & Construction, a Department of Management Studies, and departments for Sciences and Humanities.
universities.campusLifestyle: The institute is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu's capital city on India's southeastern coast. Chennai has a tropical wet and dry climate with hot summers (March to June) reaching up to 45°C and moderate winters (November to February) around 24°C. The northeast monsoon (October to December) contributes approximately 60% of the state's annual rainfall. The institute offers on-campus hostel accommodation in both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms, along with a central library, laboratories, sports facilities and a research centre.
universities.cityProfile: Chennai is India's fourth-largest metropolitan city and the capital of Tamil Nadu. It serves as a major hub for information technology, automotive manufacturing, healthcare and culture on India's Coromandel Coast. The city has extensive rail, road and air connectivity through Chennai International Airport (PNQ). The local education ecosystem includes Anna University affiliations, state government engineering colleges and numerous private institutions.
universities.practicalExposure: The institute's Schools of Computing and Bio Engineering provide access to modern laboratory facilities including AI/ML labs, IoT labs, VLSI design centers and biotechnology research equipment. The Department of Management Studies runs industry visits, case study competitions and guest lectures from management professionals. The School of Mechanical & Construction offers CAD/CAM lab access and industrial training programs. Students also benefit from the institute's AICTE IDEA Lab certification and industry partnerships.
universities.hostelOverview: On-campus hostel accommodation is available for both UG and PG students in air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned room categories. The PG Hostel A/C rate is approximately INR 90,000 per year and PG Hostel Non A/C around INR 71,000 per year (for reference). The B.Tech hostel fee structure includes a caution deposit of INR 5,000 payable once during admission. Specific rates for UG hostel rooms are not published on the official website; students should verify with the hostel administration office.
universities.scope: This record covers the main Chennai campus of Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute only. The institute operates from a single main campus location in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Programme availability, fee schedules and regulatory submissions are specific to this campus.

admissionRoutes: B.Tech: Through VTUEEE (Vel Tech University Entrance Examination) - online application with multiple phases of examination
M.Tech / MCA / MBA: Direct admission based on merit and eligibility criteria as published by the institute
sectionDetails.eligibilityNotes: B.Tech: Valid score in VTUEEE 2027 (Paper & Pencil Test / Computer Based Test) with minimum qualifications as per Anna University norms. M.Tech: Relevant Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with minimum percentage requirements. MCA: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with Mathematics at 10+2 or Bachelor's level. MBA: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks. Students appearing for final year examinations can apply provisionally.

sectionDetails.recognitionAuthority: Approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Letter of Approval (LoA) from 2018-19 with Extension of Approval (EoA) through 2026-27. Also recognized under the University Grants Commission.
